name: SILK
description: A fine smooth material spun by small creatures; soft and valued for its beauty

name: COPPER
description: A reddish metal that carries heat and current; one of the first metals worked by people

name: STEEL
description: An alloy of iron made stronger through heat; the hardest common building material

name: WHALE
description: The largest living creature of the sea; a warm-blooded giant that breathes air

name: BUTTERFLY
description: A flying creature born from change; symbol of transformation and delicate beauty

name: SPIDER
description: A creature with eight legs that spins webs; patient builder and skilled hunter

name: FROST
description: Thin ice that forms on cold surfaces; the quiet mark of winter touching the world

name: DROUGHT
description: A long period without rain; when the earth dries and life becomes scarce

name: MERCHANT
description: One who buys and sells goods for a living; a person who connects supply and need

name: GUARDIAN
description: One who watches over and protects another; a keeper of safety and care

name: ANCESTOR
description: One who came before in the line of family; the source from which later generations grow

name: SINCE
description: From that time onward; because of what came before

name: UNTIL
description: Up to the point in time when something happens; the boundary of waiting

name: WHETHER
description: Introducing a choice between possibilities; a word that holds two paths open

name: MEANWHILE
description: During the same time as something else; two things happening at once

name: ORANGE
description: The color between red and yellow; the warm hue of sunset and ripe fruit

name: PINK
description: A pale shade of red; the gentle color of blossoms and early dawn

name: MINUTE
description: A short measure of time equal to sixty seconds; a small but counted span

name: ERA
description: A long distinct period of history defined by its character; an age of the world
